tagline: Leading provider of integrated construction, mechanical, electrical, and facilities services.
hero_kpi_rationale: EMCOR achieved a record revenue of $16.99 billion in 2025, demonstrating significant growth of 16.6% in a competitive market. This figure reflects the company's ability to meet broad-based demand across its diverse construction and facilities services segments.

kpis.name: Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total sales amount generated by the company during a fiscal year.
kpis.description: EMCOR reported record revenues of $16.99 billion in 2025, up 16.6% from the prior year, driven by broad-based demand across most market sectors.
kpis.signal: Record revenue growth, indicating strong demand for its services.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin was 19.3% in 2025, a slight improvement from 19.0% in 2024, reflecting effective management of service costs.
kpis.signal: Modest improvement in gross margin, indicating efficient management of production costs.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating margin reached 10.1% in 2025, compared to 9.2% in 2024. The year 2025 includes a $144.9 million gain from the sale of UK operations, positively impacting margin by 85 basis points.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in operating margin, driven by asset divestiture and contributions from U.S. construction segments.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Total profit of the company after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income attributable to EMCOR Group, Inc. was $1.27 billion in 2025, an increase of 26.4% from 2024, benefiting from higher revenues and a reduced share count.
kpis.signal: Strong net income growth, exceeding revenue growth, due to improved operating margin and share buybacks.

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.explanation: Company's net income divided by total outstanding shares, adjusted for options and other dilutive securities.
kpis.description: Diluted earnings per share reached $28.19 in 2025, up 30.9% from 2024, primarily due to higher operating profit and a lower average share count.
kpis.signal: EPS growth exceeding net income growth, highlighting the positive impact of share repurchases on per-share profitability.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Amount of cash generated by the company's operating activities.
kpis.description: Net cash provided by operating activities was $1.30 billion in 2025, a decrease of $105.8 million from 2024, primarily due to an increase in working capital requirements related to advancing construction projects.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in operating cash flow due to higher working capital needs, despite increased net income.

kpis.name: Open Purchase Obligations
kpis.explanation: Financial commitments for goods or services to be received under construction and service contracts.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, EMCOR had $3.07 billion in open purchase obligations, with approximately $2.63 billion expected within the next 12 months. These obligations are tied to construction and service contracts and are expected to be recovered through customer billing.
kpis.signal: Significant volume of purchase obligations, reflecting operational activity and future supply needs.

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.8 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.045 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 3.5% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years 10-K reported.
kpis.signal: Revenue of $16.986 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.short: Gain on sale of United Kingdom operations
kpis.name: Gain on sale of United Kingdom operations
kpis.explanation: Profit realized from the sale of the company's operations in the United Kingdom.
kpis.description: The sale of UK operations in 2025 generated an exceptional gain of $144.9 million, positively contributing to net income and operating margin for the year.
kpis.signal: Significant one-time impact on 2025 financial results.

kpis.name: Dividend Increase Announcement
kpis.explanation: Board of directors' decision to increase the quarterly dividend.
kpis.description: In December 2025, the board of directors announced its intention to increase the regular quarterly dividend to $0.40 per share, effective January 2026, demonstrating a positive outlook on the company's future performance.
kpis.signal: Management confidence in future performance and commitment to shareholder returns.
